subject: Quantica POC — request for temporary streaming endpoint SLAs (TTFT and token/sec)
messages:
From: Ingrid Sorensen <ingrid@quantica.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quantica POC — streaming endpoint performance and contract carveout

Hi Tessa,

We're starting the integration POC this week and our engineering team hit a blocker around streaming vs non-streaming behaviour. Our functional tests show significant variance in time-to-first-token (TTFT) and sustained tokens/sec between the streaming endpoint and the synchronous/batched endpoint you've offered.

Summary of our observations (attached logs):
- For short prompts (~30 tokens) our observed TTFT on streaming is ~320-420ms p95; non-streaming responses typically start at ~180ms.
- Sustained token rates on the streaming path are ~30 tps for long-form streaming workloads; we need ~60 tps baseline for production POC, with peaks up to 120 tps.

We understand product differences exist, but for the POC we need a temporary SLA carveout (or configuration guidance) that ensures: TTFT <= 250ms p95 for streaming, and sustained token/sec >= 60 for the 2-week POC window. If a temporary dedicated pool or pinned model variant is required, we're open.

I've attached the test harness logs and a short service sheet describing our traffic patterns. Can we get an exception or an operational plan we can include in our mutual action plan?

Thanks,
Ingrid

Attachments: quantica-test-harness-logs.zip, quantica-service-sheet.xlsx

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Ingrid Sorensen <ingrid@quantica.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quantica POC — streaming endpoint performance and contract carveout

Hi Ingrid — thanks for the detailed notes and logs.

High-level: we can support a POC carveout but need to put a few guardrails in place (monitoring, short duration, and fallbacks). Before I propose specifics to legal/ops I need two things from your side:
1) a representative production traffic replay (10–20 minutes) and the target SLA window (you said 2 weeks — confirm)
2) confirmation whether you require hosted (our API) or Dedicated for the POC; Dedicated makes token/sec guarantees easier but takes lead time.

Provisional path:
- Short-term exception: temporarily accept a relaxed streaming SLO but with explicit TTFT and token/sec thresholds and an alerting cadence. We'll instrument the POC with our tracing and give you a read-only dashboard.
- If you need hard guarantees for production we recommend Reserved/Dedicated capacity.

I've opened HubSpot deal QNT-4521 and linked the logs. Please send the replay when convenient and I will kick off the internal review (cc'ing Ben who owns POC capacity, and Rishi for SLO gating).

— Tessa

Attachment: none

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-06T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Quantica POC — streaming endpoint performance and contract carveout

Ben / Rishi — forwarding Quantica's ask. Quick summary of what they want: hard-seeming TTFT <= 250ms p95 for streaming during the 2-week POC and sustained token/sec >= 60.

Technical notes from our initial analysis of their replay logs:
- Their playback shows p95 streaming TTFT ~350ms–400ms on our shared-hosted pool; non-streaming is ~160–200ms.
- Sustained token throughput for that particular test hovered ~28–35 tps on the streaming path.

Proposal for a temporary carveout (3 items):
1) 90-day temporary SLO exception (we can shorten later) with the following POC SLOs: streaming TTFT p95 <= 350ms; sustained token/sec baseline >= 40; peak handling up to 110 tps best-effort. (Keeps risk manageable.)
2) Instrumentation: Quantica will run a 15-minute replay before we start and we'll enable tracing + a read-only SLO dashboard for them. We'll set alerts at 2x threshold and an escalation path to infra.
3) Commercial/ops: We attach a one-time addendum outlining the SLO carveout; pricing for a short Dedicated burst if they want guaranteed 60+ tps.

Risk and ask: If you sign off we need Ben to allocate a small burst-dedicated pool or an isolated queue for the POC, and Rishi to greenlight the SLO tweak and monitoring hooks. Also recommend a DocuSign addendum to avoid surprises.

Questions:
- Ben: can we allocate a 1-GPU dedicated burst (48–72 hour window) or a pinned soft pool for the POC start next week?
- Rishi: any objections to the 350ms p95 / 40 tps temporary thresholds from a compliance/SLO policy perspective?

Thanks — Tessa

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Ingrid Sorensen <ingrid@quantica.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-07T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Quantica POC — approved temporary SLO addendum and next steps

Hi Ingrid — following internal review, we can proceed with a short, conditional SLO addendum for the POC.

Key points (attached addendum):
- Duration: 30-day POC window (starts on your first replay day). We kept this short to limit exposure.
- Streaming SLO (POC): TTFT p95 <= 350ms; sustained token/sec baseline >= 40 tps; peak handling rated best-effort to 110 tps.
- Observability: We'll provide a read-only dashboard and set auto-alerts. If metrics degrade >10% vs the POC baseline for more than 10 minutes we'll execute a mitigation playbook.
- Operational guardrails: we require Quantica to run the 15-minute replay prior to POC kick-off and to acknowledge the addendum via DocuSign. If hard 60 tps guarantees are needed, we recommend a short Dedicated burst (pricing/provisioning details attached).

Next actions for you:
1) Sign the attached SLO addendum (slo-addendum-quantica.pdf) via DocuSign link below.
2) Run the 15-minute replay and share the results.
3) Let me know your preferred POC start date and whether you'd like us to provision a dedicated burst.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/ENVELOPE-XYZ-4521
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/4521

Looking forward to getting this moving — Tessa

Attachment: slo-addendum-quantica.pdf
